_note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-13; reciprocal negatives against chat-harness-workflow-facts/chat-harness-guardrail-facts/chat-harness-tool-facts/chat-harness-logging-facts added 2026-07-13 per independent audit). Positives split across the two axes: a13 knowledge-packs-and-cited-retrieval (authoring a searchable, cited corpus instead of dumping prose into context) and a14 durable-memory-vs-ephemeral-task-state (persisting facts/preferences across sessions, distinct from in-session task state). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: chat-harness-routing-facts (a sibling in this plugin family — routing a REQUEST to a capability, not persisting FACTS across sessions), llm-streaming-facts (a genuinely different plugin sibling — streaming a MODEL'S live output, not a durable knowledge/memory store), chat-harness-workflow-facts (composing agents that act, not persisting facts across sessions), chat-harness-guardrail-facts (standing rules enforced every turn, not durable facts recalled on demand), chat-harness-tool-facts (the tool/resource/service distinction, not where a fact is stored), chat-harness-logging-facts (measuring routing accuracy over time, not memory/knowledge persistence), plus a genuine build/implement ask (this pack answers, it does not build).
